### Executive Overview
Design and build the user-facing web applications for PettyFlow: a mobile-first PWA for branch custodians and a real-time management dashboard for Line Managers and Finance Directors.

### Scope & Deliverables
- [ ] Mobile-first PWA: Receipt capture camera integration, offline expense draft storage, and float balance widget.
- [ ] Management Dashboard: Real-time approval inbox with tier badges (Tier 1 Auto, Tier 2 Manager, Tier 3 CFO).
- [ ] 1-Click approval and rejection workflows with mandatory audit reasoning.
- [ ] Real-time WebSocket live feed for instant status updates.

### Acceptance Criteria
- PWA is fully responsive and installable on iOS and Android devices.
- Management dashboard loads and renders approval queue in $< 200\text{ ms}$.
